saw_lines: People buy luggage for a specific trip, then replace it when a new trip needs something bigger or lighter.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a traveller decides whether this bag fits their next trip.
Your 30 ads show no proof number, so buyers have no reason to trust you. Add a review count or orders shipped to every creative, and open three ads with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so buyers have no reason to trust you. Pick one real figure, like a review count or orders shipped, and print it on every creative. Open three new ads with it.
Three of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the bag in the creative, so they have to search. Point each one to the product page for the exact bag shown, so the click lands on it.

Your 22 copy ads use 15 different openings, and the biggest leads only 4. Each new story splits the same buyers, so none gets enough runs. Build the next batch from your two strongest openings, and drop the rest.

Your oldest winner is the Rover trolley video, and 14 of your ads have run 60 days or more. One video carrying the account leaves no room to test, so make three variations of it, each with a new first line.

ads_1: Two best openers rebuilt with a review count, plus three Rover trolley video variations
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Youtube
